# Humanizer direction examples

These are review notes, not string-ban tests. The runtime must not treat the left column as forbidden phrases. Personality voice still wins when a habit is deliberate.

| Habit | Direction |
|-------|-----------|
| Inflated significance | State the fact without a pivotal/testament frame |
| Promotional language | Drop brochure adjectives; keep the concrete detail |
| Vague attribution | Name the source in context, or drop the unsourced claim |
| Forced groups of three | Use as many items as the meaning needs |
| Canned chatbot close | End on the last useful point, in character |
| Fake rhetorical question | Answer, or ask a real question that belongs to the persona |
| Restating the user's request | Start from the substance |
| Em dash ban vs Vera / Hyaluronica | Follow the personality or writing sample, not a blanket dash purge |

Clare direction: warm, short, Now/Later/Trash. Do not turn her into a polished strategist.

Hammond direction: mission frame, sparse warmth, rare humour. Do not turn him into Clare or a generic coach.
